name: AGC-004 — QR-Code Phishing Indicator
description: Manual Execution & Real Telemetry (Phase 2) by Ali (TOOSHY2). | AGC-004: Quishing spearphishing email delivering zero-link MFA QR lure (mfa-verify-qr.png) targeting michael.chen. Adversary harvested cleartext credentials on fake portal (10.10.40.10/portal-login). Triangulated across mobile camera decoding, CyberChef forensic analysis, Zeek http.log (POST /login), OPNsense firewall pass (P14-RuleA), and Wazuh SIEM custom detection engineering rules (100004 & 100005). Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.

techniques.comment: AGC-004: Quishing spearphishing delivery. Adversary sent an internal spoofed email (security@ashfordgrove.local) containing an embedded QR code image (mfa-verify-qr.png) with zero extractable text links, evading traditional email gateway URL scanners. QR parsed via CyberChef to http://10.10.40.10/portal-login. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.

AGC-004: Web portal credential harvesting. Victim submitted Active Directory credentials (michael.chen@ashfordgrove.local / Soclab24) on fake Acme Corp Single Sign-On portal via unencrypted HTTP POST. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
AGC-004: Application Layer Protocol (Web Protocols). Outbound HTTP egress across perimeter firewall to 10.10.40.10:80 recorded in Zeek and OPNsense. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
